description: Renovate for cert-warden: bump pinned third-party actions (SHA+comment), tool versions via regex annotations, and harness container images. Internal dsb-norge/cert-warden refs are release-please's job — never Renovate's.

packageRules.description: Harness images are consumed tag@digest: tags are mutable at the registry, so the digest is the actual pin. pinDigests makes Renovate add digests to new images and bump tag+digest together.

customManagers.description: Tool versions declared as env vars/inputs annotated with `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` on the preceding line. Values must not contain `@` — tag@sha pairs belong to the digest-pair manager below.

Annotated tag@commit pairs (`vX.Y.Z@<40-hex sha>`, e.g. BATS_CORE_REF): the sha is the enforced pin (verified at install), the tag is for humans. github-tags digests resolve to the tag's commit, so Renovate bumps both halves together.
